description: This file defines external API prototypes for the Module Container component in the ANSC (Advanced Networking Service Container) framework, including creation, removal, object enrollment, initialization, and sub-engine engagement functions.

methods.name: AnscCreateModuleContainer
methods.description: Creates a new Module Container instance with provided context handles.

methods.name: AnscMcoCreate
methods.description: Creates a Module Container object with specified context handles.

methods.name: AnscMcoRemove
methods.description: Removes or deletes a Module Container object.

methods.name: AnscMcoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects or components into the Module Container.

methods.name: AnscMcoSubEngage
methods.description: Engages or activates the sub-engine within the Module Container.

methods.name: AnscMcoSubCancel
methods.description: Cancels or deactivates the sub-engine within the Module Container.
